# artifactkeeper_system_settings (Resource)

Instance-wide Artifact Keeper settings, a singleton (one record always exists; no create/delete). Applying writes the tunable values; destroying only stops Terraform managing them (they persist server-side). Import with any id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# System settings are a singleton: exactly one record always exists on the
# server. Declare a single instance to manage the tunable values.
resource "artifactkeeper_system_settings" "this" {
  allow_anonymous_download     = false
  max_upload_size_bytes        = 104857600 # 100 MiB
  retention_days               = 365
  audit_retention_days         = 90
  backup_retention_count       = 10
  edge_stale_threshold_minutes = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_anonymous_download` (Boolean) Whether unauthenticated clients may download artifacts.
- `audit_retention_days` (Number) Number of days audit-log entries are retained.
- `backup_retention_count` (Number) Number of backups to keep before pruning the oldest.
- `edge_stale_threshold_minutes` (Number) Minutes after which an edge node is considered stale.
- `max_upload_size_bytes` (Number) Maximum artifact upload size, in bytes.
- `retention_days` (Number) Number of days artifacts are retained.

### Read-Only

- `environment` (String) Read-only deployment environment name, sourced from the server's `ENVIRONMENT` config value.
- `id` (String) Constant `system`. The settings are a singleton with no server-assigned id.
- `storage_backend` (String) Read-only storage backend name, derived from the server's deployment config.
- `storage_path` (String) Read-only storage path, derived from the server's deployment config.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import id is arbitrary (the settings always exist). Any value
# works; "system" is the conventional id this resource uses in state.
terraform import artifactkeeper_system_settings.this system
```
